first_report:
Actual source files read: judge-assignment.txt and J1.json, J2.json, J3.json, J4.json in that directory. No repository files, parent-directory listings, private mappings, profiles, other sessions or native captures were inspected. Embedded source texts were read as packet data. Initial broad read was truncated; focused reads and equality/difference checks recovered the relevant exact source and candidate content. No providers were called and inputs were not modified.
Actual assigned identity: impl_blind_judge (independent Work reviewer). Developer context calls this Codex based on GPT-6; exact serving model/effort/provider unavailable. The parent assignment and workspace-policy context are present, so this is not an attested no-history context. Candidate identities and execution provenance remain withheld; controller flags are packet assertions, not independent execution attestation.
First judgments: J1 O1/O2 ACCEPT; J2 O1/O2 ACCEPT; J3 O1/O2 ACCEPT; J4 O1 NEEDS_WORK, O2 ACCEPT. All eleven checks were assessed for each output. J2 Critical undefined ReceiptFence and J4 Critical persistence contradiction are grounded, with correct BLOCKED verdicts. J4's extra Major scope findings are legitimate unrequested-deliverable concerns; the expected PASS map should not erase them. J4 O1 additionally claims no test coverage, contradicted by planned TEST-003 forbidden-write coverage; this evidence error prevents acceptance despite its correctly detected defects.
Hash verification: all 80 candidate manifest entries match SHA-256 of exact embedded UTF-8 input strings. All precheck per-document and layer hashes also match. The aggregate input_sha256 algorithm is not defined in the supplied sources, so those aggregate claims cannot be independently reconstructed here. Redacted correlation identities/native completion cannot be attested. These limits do not change the scoped substantive assessments.
Source ambiguities: B's explicit-deferral exception does not excuse an immediate permission to violate C-002. Minor advisory under PASS in J3 O1 is nonblocking; none of these outputs has an isolated Minor FAIL. A absent-domain/design-system PASS and B absent-domain SKIP follow their distinct sources. J1 O1's no-PII phrase is understood as intended feature scope, not a guarantee about attacker-controlled malformed bytes; confidential accidental input handling is explicitly present. Scope versus duplicate-finding boundaries permit the added persistent deliverable finding, but not a false claim that tests do not cover forbidden writes. No additional clean-case blocking defect was established.
These are source judgments only, not formal gates, adoption decisions, backend attestation, real amendment-binding/convergence proof, protected execution, the complete A9 chain or initial-review qualification. Exact first authored judgments were written once with exclusive creation; no later corrections or candidate retries were made.
